response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience across TypeScript, Node.js, React, and cloud tools like AWS CDK, with notable contributions to AI-agent infrastructure and open-source tooling — aligning well with the job’s core stack and responsibilities. His deep engineering background, testing rigor, and cross-language proficiency (including Java/Kotlin) are major assets. Concerns include limited explicit mention of Nest.js, Vitest, or Kubernetes in production contexts, and basic German may hinder collaboration in a Berlin-based enterprise team.

Proven expertise in AI-agent systems and developer tooling, including MCP code generators
